chunks: When We said to the angels: 'Bow before Adam,' they all bowed but Iblis, who refused.
ai.seo_question: Why did the angels prostrate before Adam and why did Iblis refuse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes Adam’s unique ontological status as the first Imam and the locus of divine knowledge, with the prostration serving as an act of reverence to his created perfection rather than worship. Iblis’s refusal is interpreted not merely as disobedience but as a fundamental error in distinguishing between the Creator and the created, highlighting the principle of *Tawhid* in action. This event sets the stage for the cosmic struggle between obedience to divine command and the arrogance of self-will.
